reviews.comment: Was very disrespectful towards students and had a hostile classroom environment. I was scared most of the time talking to her.

Avoid taking her. She's passive-aggressive + unorganized. The final project itself was good, but half of semester was pointless research. Her "discussions" are vague and she speaks in run-on sentences. I can't say I learned anything new. Of the 6 studio profs I've experienced, she is ranked last.

Very condescending at the beginning of the semester. Didn't learn anything new, as she is very unorganized and can't explain a topic clearly. She gossips about her own students to former students, lol. Don't recommend. We never knew what we were being graded by. Useless studio.

She really pushes her students. This was an undergraduate level course, but the way she operated it and the quality of work she expected were more on par with graduate level. If you really want to grow, take her, but be ready to work. I rated her a 4 rather than 5 because I think she should have given us a bit more guidance in certain areas.

I would NOT recommend taking this professor. From the very start of the semester, she focused more on issues not regarding the course content and wasted our time with her 10-15-minute-long tangents on whatever she was angry at that day. She gives vague and confusing feedback and if you don't understand becomes very hostile and passive aggressive.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's such a nice and knowledgable person! If you attend class, participate, and get the work done, it should be an easy A! There's group work but she's very accessible when it comes to any problems. would definitely take again:)

Professor Calvesbert does have her benefits. She does seem to genuinely care about the subjects that she teaches. Her main issue is that she is very inconsistent in her feedback. One day she says to change something, then the paper is graded and she docked points for the change. She also took a long time grade, we had no grades until mid March.

Do not take this professor, she is a nice person in a 1 on 1 but she doesnt know how to teach a class of students. This class should not have been hard and she made it so difficult. Would not take again!!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The main problem from my experience is she's a very poor communicator. Expect to learn pretty much everything by yourself. Most of the time she just goes around the class helping everyone individually. While 50-80% of the class is raising their hand for their turn. It might take you the whole class to get your problem or question answered

Her accent/grammar was mediocre, 82.5% of class graded on papers, attendance mandatory, gave very vague answers to questions, doesn't respond quickly to emails. She focuses not on "building better cities," rather "social issues in cities." All that said, she could be much worse. While it was a lot of writing, she's a fairly easy grader on papers
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: From the beginning of this class, I knew that it was not going to be a great experience. Calvesbert constantly asks the class nonsense questions and waits for the class to try to answer but gets increasingly disrespectful to the class until she finally gives a very specific answer she expected that also doesnt make sense. Super frustrating class...
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The first day I walked into class the first impression I got was I dont like this prof. She tries her best to get her point across, but is almost always unable to. She expects you to know what youre doing in an introductory level class and is easily frustrated with the entire class and threatens to stop teaching. Tried to be understanding but
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof had a hard time staying on the topic of "Building Better Cities", she stated she would rename the class to be "Building Diverse Cities." She cares more about talking about the social issues of race rather than teaching about urban planning. She also expects you to lead class with discussions based upon vague questions. BIG LANGUAGE BARRIER

Easily frustrated by students who can't answer her vague questions. She expects students to drive the class while she just provides confusing prompts. She wants you to drive your project on your own and keeps encouraging you to pick a direction and go with it, but only as long as she finds it interesting. If not, she'll be very passive aggressive.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects
